cohort: A total of 175 women, aged 20-40 years, with pelvic Endometriosis complicated by infertility, who underwent laparoscopy in the study hospital between January 2014 and December 2018.
finding: Age, infertility type, GnRH-a treatment, r-AFS grade, and operative method were significant factors influencing pregnancy outcome after laparoscopic treatment for endometriosis-associated infertility.
